title: Minimize window when clicking on its icon if it was the last-active window and isn't active only because a Panel widget is active
line: Clicking the task of the window you were using while Kickoff or another panel popup is open now minimizes it and closes the popup.
explanation: Opening Kickoff (for example with Meta) or another Plasma popup makes that popup the active window, so the task manager no longer saw the window underneath as active and clicking its task activated it again instead of minimizing it. The task manager now remembers the last active window, and when a Plasma popup has focus and no other window is active, clicking that window's task minimizes it and closes the popup. The memory is cleared when the virtual desktop or activity changes.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: minimize last active window behind Plasma popups

Opening Kickoff or another Plasma popup takes focus from the active
window, so clicking its task activated it again instead of minimizing
it. Treat it as still active then, and close the popup after minimizing.

BUG: 463836
